title: I asked 5.6 Sol Ultra to build me a game 😳
author: Any_Grass_7932
selftext:
https://reddit.com/link/1uwatau/video/if0z4vw3k7dh1/player

So, I randomly decided to test how powerful 5.6 Sol Ultra really is by having it help me build a game

I designed the rider and gave the model a bunch of instructions, but I’ve never built a game before, coded a game, or even considered myself much of a gamer. Honestly, I was mostly messing around to see whether someone with zero experience could turn an idea into something playable with AI.

I’m wondering whether it’s worth adding more levels, enemies, upgrades, bosses, and whatever else—or whether I should accept that it’s shit and move on.

Game link: [https://driftbound-arcane-overdrive.prophotostudio.chatgpt.site](https://driftbound-arcane-overdrive.prophotostudio.chatgpt.site)

Now Give it a try and be brutally honest. Would you actually play more of this? What works, what sucks, and what would make it better?

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: Its a start but too easy, I just click and BOOM they die. Whats the core loop and progression going to be? What is the story?

replies.author: Any_Grass_7932
replies.body: Fair feedback. Right now, enemies are too easy to defeat. In the next version, players will drift to build power, use lightning to weaken enemies, then Vault or crash into them to finish the fight. Upgrades will visibly change the motorcycle. The story will be about restoring four Arc Beacons and defeating the corrupted Warden. Thanks for the honest feedback.

comments.author: captain_proton
comments.body: Certainly a lot of text and menus, its a bit overwhelming. Its not shit, the setting is fine. What does this game do differently to similar ones out there?

replies.author: Any_Grass_7932
replies.body: That’s fair. I’ve added too much text because the main idea wasn’t clear enough. The goal is to make the motorcycle itself the weapon: drift around monsters to create a lightning circuit, then Vault through it to destroy the group. The next version will have less text and teach the game while you play. Thanks—this is very useful feedback.

replies.author: captain_proton
replies.body: You're welcome. I've had recent feedback on my own game about too much text!

comments.author: breaker_h
comments.body: How are the assets made? You've added them manually?

replies.author: Any_Grass_7932
replies.body: The assets were made partially in claude design and refined in photoshop

comments.author: JEvideal
comments.body: Its nice to look at, payable, but I was honestly a bit lost in all of it while it seems that I just have to keep the finger on my screen to kill everything. Didnt understand what the upgrades really do. I didnt even see my a healthbar or felt a danger - maybe its clearer on desktop than on mobile.

replies.author: Any_Grass_7932
replies.body: Thanks, this is very useful. The mobile version now makes holding FIRE too powerful, and the health and upgrades are not clear enough. I need to make danger easier to see, make every upgrade feel different, and give players a reason to drift, release FIRE and use Vault.

comments.author: Interesting-Yellow-4
comments.body: I think that looks prety interesting to be honest.

comments.author: Fuzzzy420
comments.body:
Usually the ai makes to easy content. 

You went through all that trouble. It seems you like the game, so does it really matter if we like it? If you like it, continue development, just for the fun of it.

comments.author: salihbaki
comments.body: It is super laggy in mobile. And I don’t know why but all the ai games looks similar in terms of ui. Colors shapes maybe gradient usage. Not bad though
